EmailTemplate.subject: Tune in for our New Live Healthcare Series
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Healthy Bites: Live will bring together leading experts in the healthcare space to share key learnings and experiences in a “bite sized” 15 minute live discussion on Linkedin.
Join us tomorrow at 12:30pm est for our very first event, Removing Risk From the Payment Experience in Healthcare <[[https://www.linkedin.com/events/6762486812167553024/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, featuring Dan Arntz, President of US Operations at Eckoh.
Being PCI compliant doesn’t mean that you’re secure. Under today’s rules, if you still have data traversing your environment, you haven’t removed all the risk. Tomorrow we’ll share insights into how to make your payment environment safer.
If you haven’t yet registered for the event, you can do so here <[[https://www.linkedin.com/events/6762486812167553024/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>.
See you there!
Regards,
